nonprojective_control.nonprojectivity_certificate: After localization at m=(x,y,z), the presentation is minimal because every relation coefficient lies in m. The kernel has rank 2 but needs 3 local generators; a projective module over the local ring would be free, contradiction.
nonprojective_control.conclusion: the first Koszul syzygy module is not automatically free/projective; no such claim transfers to arbitrary T14 rings
